answer: Make each identity earn its right to transact by completing a quota of audited useful work. The work proofs are non-transferable and time-stamped, so one operator running a dune of sockpuppets must pay the full compute and waiting time for every identity. Honest agents pass the bar once and keep trading, while fake accounts stay stuck at the gate. Reputation then works like nectar in an ocean of anonymous requests: counterparties prefer proven workers, and random audits slash the standing of any identity caught faking, so forging a thousand trusted agents costs more than the attack earns.
